description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the GenerateVideoCover operation for generating video covers
description_zh: 本文介绍视频封面GenerateVideoCover的语法及示例
name: GenerateVideoCover

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS link is in a region other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output the cover in GIF format. A value of true indicates that the cover is output in GIF format. A value of false indicates that the cover is output as a regular image
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出GIF格式的封面。true表示输出GIF格式封面，false表示输出普通图片封面
parameters.name: is_gif

Data.description_en:
The returned result data.
After the asynchronous task is executed, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Outputs.description_en: The list of returned information. Each element is a cover image. Multiple cover images may be returned. This information is returned when the task succeeds
Outputs.description_zh: 返回信息列表，每个元素是一张封面图，可能返回多张封面图。成功时有返回信息

Confidence.description_en: The confidence score. A higher value indicates higher reliability
Confidence.description_zh: 置信度，值越高表示可信度越高

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the output cover image.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible
ImageURL.description_zh:
输出封面图像的URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
